newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian child sex and murder scandal.
newsitem.headline: Belgian child sex and murder scandal.

text.p: Following is a chronology of the main events in Belgium's unfolding child sex scandal. Since August, police have found the remains of four girls and two more were rescued alive though sexually abused. A total of 13 people have been charged with various offences.
June 1995: Julie Lejeune and Melissa Russo, both eight years old, disappear while on a walk by a motorway bridge near their home in Grace-Hollogne, eastern Belgium.

Aug 22, 1995: An Marchal, 17, and Eefje Lambrecks 19, disappear in Belgian port of Ostend after seeing a hypnotist's show while on holiday. The teenagers were last seen alighting from a tram. Police visit convicted child rapist Marc Dutroux at house where it is later discovered the girls are being held.

Dec 1995: Police investigating theft visit Dutroux, 39, at home again, hear childrens' voices but find nothing. Dutroux later arrested on car theft and related charges, spends almost four months in jail. Dutroux was let out of jail in 1992 after serving three years of 13-year sentence for multiple child rape.
Feb/March 1996: Around this time Melissa Russo and Julie Lejeune, held in one of Dutroux's houses, die of starvation.
May 28: Sabine Dardenne, 12, disappears.
Aug 9: Laetitia Delhez, 14, disappears.
Aug 13: Dutroux, accomplice Michel Lelievre, and Dutroux's second wife Michelle Martin held as police search for Laetitia.

Aug 15: Dutroux leads police to makeshift dungeon in a terraced house he owns in Marcinelles, a suburb of Charleroi and one of six houses he owns in and around the city where they find Laetitia and Sabine. Both have been drugged and sexually abused.
Aug 16: Dutroux and Lelievre charged with abduction and illegal imprisonment of children.

Aug 17: Dutroux takes police to bodies of Julie and Melissa, buried in garden of his house in Sars-La-Buissiere along with body of accomplice Bernard Weinstein. Dutroux admits killing Weinstein and kidnapping An and Eefje. Police start searches at Dutroux's five other houses, uncover 300 child porn videos, magazines, childrens' clothes, gun and soporific drugs.
Aug 19: Martin charged as an accomplice kidnappings.
Aug 20: Police find more cells in a Dutroux house in Charleroi suburb Marchienne-au-Pont. Brussels businessman Jean-Michel Nihoul charged with criminal association.
Aug 22: Julie and Melissa buried in virtually a state funeral in Liege. Michael Diakostavrianos, of Greek origin, arrested and charged with criminal associaton.
Aug 25: Police looking at the child kidnap scandal arrest Chief Detective Georges Zicot, a specialist in vehicle theft cases, for truck theft, forgery and insurance fraud.
Sept 3: Police find remains of An Marchal and Eefje Lambrecks under shed in garden of house in Charleroi suburb of Jumet owned by Dutroux and formerly occupied by Weinstein.
Sept 7: An and Eefje buried seperately in Hasselt.
Sept 24: Dutroux charged with murder of Weinstein.
Sept 13: Nihoul charged with abduction.
Sept 30: Gendarme Gerard Vannesse arrested on charges of drug trafficking and car theft. Released on Oct 4
Oct 7: Martin charged also with criminal association.
